{{Quote|And that tractor-robot treading up the stairs behind you...he yours?|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
A '''tracked labor droid''', also known as a '''tractor droid''', '''tractor-robot''', or "'''trakkie'''", was a type of [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]]. Looking like a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] on treads, it was equipped with a pair of telescopic [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. Tractor droids were strong enough to pull moving [[skyspeeder]]s down out of the air.

[[FE-9Q]] was an old tractor droid.
